Athletic male model in a bright blue insulated winter jacket, black snow pants, gloves, and sunglasses, stepping forward in a snowy environment. Snow particles flying, dramatic motion. Fit male hiker climbing rocky terrain, wearing an olive green shirt, black trekking pants, and a large black backpack with orange straps. Dust and debris kicking up from the ground. Energetic female runner in motion wearing a purple athletic t-shirt, black shorts, and running shoes. High-resolution, photorealistic sportswear campaign

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vintage mythical travel poster for Troy, showing an idealized ancient city as a dream travel destination.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, warm cream border and a large illustrated scene above a typography block. Use a clean mid-century travel-poster style with simplified geometric shapes, soft grain, flat colors, and subtle paper texture.

Scene: A sunlit Bronze Age coastal city in Anatolia, viewed from the shore looking inland. At the bottom of the illustration, show turquoise sea water with two thin white wave lines, then a sandy beach and a straight stone path leading toward a massive fortified city gate. The path is made of irregular reddish paving stones and should create strong central perspective.

Architecture and landscape: The city has pale limestone defensive walls with crenellations, two large front gate towers, and a dark rectangular central entrance. Behind the walls, show a hillside town of terracotta-roofed houses in ochre, clay, cream, and rust tones. Include one classical temple with columns near the upper center and one tall watchtower on the upper right with a red roof and a small flame beacon. In the far background, include soft green rolling hills under a pale blue-to-cream sky. Place a simple round golden sun high above the city.

Foreground details: In front of the gate, include exactly 1 large wooden Trojan horse centered slightly right of the entrance. Include exactly 4 tiny human figures: 2 standing near the horse on the left side, and 2 standing near the horse on the right side. Add a ceremonial line of round shields and spears along the base of the wall; make them decorative and evenly spaced. Include exactly 3 tall dark green cypress trees: 1 on the left foreground and 2 on the right foreground. Add low shrubs and scattered rocks along both sides of the path.

Text content: In the bottom cream typography panel, set the main title as TROY in very large uppercase burnt-orange geometric lettering with wide spacing. Beneath it, add the subtitle ANATOLIA • 1200 BC in small uppercase teal lettering. Add a short gold horizontal divider line. At the bottom, add the italic tagline Explore worlds like these in Visionaria — First Cinematic Imagination App in warm ochre.

Visual style: Elegant retro travel poster, simplified historic fantasy illustration, balanced symmetry, warm Mediterranean palette, soft shadows, no photorealism, no modern objects, no extra logos or watermarks.\

Goal: Create a visually stunning modern recipe card for Mojito, presented as a luxurious tropical social-media recipe poster.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 portrait layout, bright white background with soft beach-and-ocean blur behind the hero drink, airy margins, watercolor lime-green splashes around the edges, subtle mint leaf textures, gold ornamental line accents, and a fresh upscale cocktail-bar aesthetic.

Layout: Top-left title area with a tiny gold cocktail icon, the small uppercase label “CUBAN SUMMER DRINK,” a huge flowing dark-green script title “Mojito,” then the tagline “cool • citrusy • refreshing.” Under it add a short description: “A classic Cuban cocktail with crisp mint, zesty lime, and a splash of sunshine.” Add a handwritten line: “Sip. Relax. Repeat.” On the right side place a tall crystal highball glass filled with crushed ice, lime wedges, mint leaves, bubbles, and condensation, garnished with a lime wheel and mint sprig; include tropical palm shadows and limes/mint on the table.

Ingredients section: Create one elegant bordered card labeled “INGREDIENTS” with exactly 6 ingredient rows, each with a small watercolor-style icon and text: 1) “1 Lime” with subtext “cut into wedges,” 2) “10–12 Mint Leaves” with subtext “fresh & fragrant,” 3) “Soda Water” with subtext “to top up,” 4) “2 tsp Sugar” with subtext “adjust to taste,” 5) “60 ml White Rum” with subtext “(2 oz),” 6) “Crushed Ice” with subtext “as much as you love.”

Tip card: To the right of the ingredients, add one smaller pale-green bordered card with mint illustration and exactly 2 text blocks: top label “TIP” with the note “Lightly crush mint — don’t over-muddle,” and bottom label “PERFECT BALANCE” with “1 Lime : 2 tsp Sugar” plus handwritten text “sweet, citrusy, just right!”

How-to section: Along the lower half, add the heading “HOW TO MAKE THE PERFECT MOJITO” and exactly 5 numbered illustrated steps connected by small gold arrows: 1) muddling mint, sugar, and lime in a glass with a wooden muddler, caption “Muddle mint leaves with sugar and lime. Gently press to release the flavors.” 2) filling a glass with crushed ice, caption “Fill glass with crushed ice. Crushed ice = maximum chill.” 3) pouring white rum and soda water into the glass, caption “Pour white rum and soda water. Add rum, then top up with soda water.” 4) stirring with a bar spoon, caption “Stir gently for balanced flavor. Mix lightly to keep it refreshing.” 5) finished mojito with mint sprig and lime wheel, caption “Garnish with mint sprig and lime wheel. The final touch of summer.”

Footer: Add small uppercase text “REFRESHING • VIBRANT • TIMELESS” and handwritten gold script “Made for sunny days and good vibes!” with a small heart doodle. Decorate the corners with watercolor lime slices, mint sprigs, ice cubes, bubbles, and splashes.

Visual style: Minimal yet artistic, polished editorial recipe-card design, watercolor botanical accents mixed with realistic cocktail photography, fresh lime green, mint green, white, pale aqua, and muted gold. Use elegant serif/sans-serif typography paired with large hand-lettered script for the title.

Constraints: Keep all text legible, maintain the exact counts of 6 ingredient rows, 2 tip-card text blocks, and 5 numbered preparation steps. No people, no watermark, no extra recipe steps, no clutter.\

prompt_en: A dramatic luxury product advertising image for a motorsport-inspired chronograph wristwatch in a dark studio. Center-left foreground, show a single stainless steel chronograph watch standing upright at a slight three-quarter angle, with a black dial, two red-accent subdials, slim silver hour markers, a tachymeter bezel, and visible crown and pushers on the right side. The watch has a black leather strap with bold red stitching along both edges and a sporty premium finish. To the right of the watch, place one black square presentation box slightly behind it, textured like leather, with red stitching around the lid and a silver embossed eye-shaped logo above the text “NESS STUDIO” and smaller red text “TRACK SURFACE.” At the top center of the composition, add the same silver eye logo with the words “NESS STUDIO” and smaller “BY NICOLAS.” Across the background, place one oversized blurred word, PRECISION, in large gray capital letters spanning nearly the full width. The scene is set against a deep black background with cinematic red and white horizontal light streaks crossing behind the products from left to right, suggesting speed and racetrack energy. Use a glossy wet ground plane with reflective texture, catching red highlights and mirrorlike reflections beneath the watch and box. At the bottom center, add the text “CHRONOGRAPH SERIES” in clean white spaced capitals with thin red horizontal lines extending on both sides, and below it smaller red capitals reading ALSACE MADE. Color palette: black, charcoal gray, silver steel, vivid racing red, and a touch of white. Lighting should be high-contrast and premium, with crisp specular highlights on the metal case, subtle soft fill on the box, and moody shadows. Overall style: ultra-polished commercial product photography, luxury watch campaign, sharp focus on the products, sleek branding, high-end automotive aesthetic.\

prompt_en: A bold retro propaganda-style poster illustration with a limited palette of red, black, and warm cream on a lightly aged paper texture. The composition features a dynamic anime-inspired action scene in the center: a martial artist in a white gi with a black belt carries a long-haired woman over one shoulder in a fireman's carry or wrestling throw pose. The fighter is shown from the knees up in a powerful wide stance, facing left, with the woman draped horizontally across the shoulders, her bare legs lifted and bent, her long dark hair flowing downward, and a black wide-brim cowboy hat still on her head. Render both figures in high-contrast inked line art with thick black shadows and sharp graphic contours, mixing manga character design with vintage screen-printed poster energy. Behind them, fill the background with aggressive geometric rays and wedges: 6 major red and black angular shapes radiating outward across the cream backdrop, creating a sense of impact and motion. In the top right corner, add 1 circular emblem containing a fierce gorilla or ape head icon with red accents. Across the lower third, place large bold condensed block typography integrated into the composition: the smaller line reads “SCOTTISH RECIPE:” and the huge main title reads “MINCE AND TATTIES”. Make the text red on cream and cream on black in layered diagonal banner panels, with the words occupying 3 text groupings total: “SCOTTISH RECIPE:”, “MINCE AND”, and “TATTIES”. Emphasize dramatic diagonal layout, posterized shadows, distressed print texture, and the feeling of a vintage Soviet constructivist or pulp exploitation food poster fused with martial arts manga aesthetics.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a warm, sophisticated schematic-aesthetic design systems mood board for friendly AI interface design, combining technical diagrams, vintage paper textures, and subtle futuristic UI symbols.

Canvas: Wide horizontal image, approximately 16:9, with a dark charcoal background and a centered 2-row by 3-column grid of six rectangular panels separated by thick black gutters. The overall mood is warm, archival, precise, and slightly mysterious, like a design-system exploration wall.

Layout: Use exactly 6 panels:
1. Top-left panel: dark navy/black technical blueprint with an orbital spiral or galaxy-like contour diagram, fine cyan linework, small glowing amber dots, vertical measuring lines, tiny unreadable annotations, and a small boxed icon near the bottom right.
2. Top-middle panel: cream paper schematic of a cute rounded robot face, made from layered rounded-rectangle contour lines, two teal dot eyes, a small peach smile, vertical and horizontal construction lines, small crosshair marks, and faint measurement notations.
3. Top-right panel: warm beige abstract architectural flight-path schematic with sweeping teal and gray arcs, angular line structures, fine grid lines, crosshairs, orange glow points, and tiny technical labels.
4. Bottom-left panel: aged spiral-bound notebook page with paper tape on the corners, circular radar charts, geometric construction diagrams, small UI glyphs, a peach smiley sticker in the upper right, a small card near the bottom left, and a red hexagonal stamp near the bottom right.
5. Bottom-middle panel: misty futuristic architectural landscape or plaza in muted teal and tan, overlaid with perspective grids, fine UI measurement lines, subtle orange highlights, and translucent schematic annotations.
6. Bottom-right panel: dark charcoal icon-system sheet containing exactly 54 small geometric UI glyphs arranged in a clean grid, using thin teal, peach, and beige lines; include circles, sliders, crosshairs, brackets, arrows, nodes, target symbols, grids, and abstract interface controls.

Visual style: Warm take on technical schematics; combine Bauhaus-like precision, mid-century information design, old engineering drawings, soft futuristic interface graphics, and tactile analog materials. Use muted colors: charcoal black, faded cream, parchment beige, dusty teal, pale cyan, peach, amber, and soft gray. Lines should be extremely fine and precise, with subtle glow only on small highlights. Add paper grain, scan texture, faint speckles, worn edges, and layered transparent drafting marks.

Text and marks: Include tiny pseudo-technical annotations and measurement ticks, but keep all text mostly illegible and decorative. Avoid large readable headlines. Use minimal symbols such as plus signs, crosshairs, coordinates, micro labels, and tiny rule marks.

Constraints: No people, no photorealistic objects except paper/notebook texture, no logos, no watermark, no extra panels beyond the 6 specified panels. Maintain a polished design-system exploration feel rather than a chaotic collage.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vertical anime bridal fashion character sheet for Roboco-san, a cybernetic idol bride in a soft pink mecha-themed wedding dress, presented as a luxury magazine design board titled WEDDING DRESS Collection.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 composition, pale blush-pink border with ornate thin lines, rose motifs, delicate filigree corners, glossy high-resolution anime illustration. Use a dreamy cathedral wedding atmosphere with stained-glass windows, sheer curtains, sparkling floor reflections, floating petals, soft bloom lighting, and a romantic pink-white color palette.

Main layout: Split the page into two major columns. The left column is a large full-body hero illustration taking about half the canvas width. The right column is a detailed fashion-spec panel with title, description text, and multiple labeled inset views. Add a bottom information strip spanning the page.

Hero illustration: Show one full-body anime bride with very long brown to rose-pink gradient hair, flowing waist-length twin-tail-like hair strands, a pink rose flower crown, translucent veil, and a gentle bridal pose holding a large bouquet. Her face should be softly obscured or simplified with no sharp facial detail. She wears a white and blush-pink asymmetrical wedding dress with a corset bodice, heart-shaped neckline, off-shoulder puff sleeves, layered ruffled skirt, translucent overskirt, pink ribbons, rose decorations, pearl-like trim, silver mechanical accents, and one visible cybernetic/mecha leg. Include high-heeled platform bridal shoes with pink roses and ankle straps. Bouquet should be round and dense with pink roses, white filler flowers, green leaves, and long trailing pink ribbons.

Visible text and typography: Use elegant serif and script typography in dusty rose. Large title on the right reads “WEDDING DRESS” with “Collection” below in cursive. Include smaller English text “Roboco-san Bridal Style 2024” and Japanese-style descriptive body copy as decorative filler. Add vertical Japanese quote on the left side of the hero illustration: キミとなら、未来もずっと幸せでいられる気がするの……♡. Add bottom center quote: キミの隣で、ずっと笑っていられますように。. Add bottom-left name label “Roboco-san” and “Bridal Style 2024”.

Right-side fashion panels: Include exactly 10 labeled inset panels. The first row has 3 full-body turnaround panels labeled “FRONT”, “SIDE”, and “BACK”. Below them are 7 detail panels labeled “BOUQUET”, “SHOULDER & BODICE”, “MECHA LEG”, “SHOES”, “BACK STYLE”, and “RIBBON DETAIL”, with the “SHOES” section split into two small shoe close-up images inside one labeled panel. The detail panels show close-ups of the bouquet, corset bust and shoulders, robotic leg joint, bridal platform heels, rear hair-and-dress silhouette, and a large pink bow with roses.

Bottom-left design information: Add a framed “Design Point” card containing exactly 4 Japanese bullet-style lines with small pink flower/star bullets. Below it add a “Color Palette” row with exactly 5 rectangular swatches labeled “Rose Pink”, “Blush Pink”, “Pearl White”, “Silver”, and “Light Rose”.

Bottom-right stats card: Add a small framed profile box with exactly 3 lines: “Height: 152cm”, “Birthday: 5 / 23”, and “Favorite: …” as tiny decorative text. Add small rose icons around the bottom strip.

Style constraints: Keep everything cohesive in pastel pink, pearl white, silver, and light rose. Use ornate bridal catalog aesthetics, clean panel borders, soft glitter, highly detailed lace and ruffles, delicate cybernetic parts, and no dark or harsh colors. The image should feel like an official idol wedding dress collection sheet rather than a simple portrait.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a clean Japanese infographic slide summarizing ガンダム・シリーズ　作中の世界・時代の関係性, with the small subtitle 「―主要シリーズの時系列と世界のつながり―」, showing how Gundam series relate by fictional world and era.

Canvas: 16:9 horizontal presentation slide, white background, navy blue title typography, thin gray borders, pale pastel category bands, compact Japanese sans-serif text. Use a crisp corporate PowerPoint-style layout with a large boxed timeline on top, two boxed rows beneath it, and notes/legend at the bottom.

Top title area: Large dark navy Japanese title at top left. At top right, include a rounded note box saying the series are broadly divided into 「宇宙世紀（UC）」 and other 「アナザー（AU）」 worlds.

Main section: A large bordered panel titled 宇宙世紀（Universal Century／UC）シリーズ with a note 「※地球を起源とする人類の歴史（1年＝宇宙世紀元年＝宇宙移民開始年）」. Inside, create a horizontal timeline with exactly 9 era columns, each with a colored header and vertical guide lines: 1) 「UC 0001 宇宙移民開始」, 2) 「UC 0079」, 3) 「UC 0087」, 4) 「UC 0093」, 5) 「UC 0123」, 6) 「UC 0153」, 7) 「UC 100」, 8) 「UC 110」, 9) 「（年代不詳）」. Add an era-label row with exactly 8 colored labels: 「黎明期」, 「一年戦争期」, 「グリプス戦役期」, 「第一次ネオ・ジオン抗争」, 「第二次ネオ・ジオン抗争」, 「ラプラスの箱の時代」, 「宇宙世紀のその後」, 「その他の時代・作品」.

Universal Century content cards: Place exactly 14 rounded rectangular series cards in the top timeline panel, using pale green, yellow, orange, purple, blue, and gray fills. Cards must read: 1) 「機動戦士ガンダム (1979) / UC 0079 / 地球連邦軍とジオン公国の戦争」, 2) 「THE ORIGIN (2015-18) / UC 0068-0079 / 一年戦争前夜の物語」, 3) 「機動戦士Zガンダム (1985) / UC 0087 / エゥーゴとティターンズの戦い（グリプス戦役）」, 4) 「機動戦士ガンダムZZ (1986-87) / UC 0088 / ZZの直後、ネオ・ジオンの台頭」, 5) 「機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア (1988) / UC 0093 / シャアの反乱とラプラスの箱」, 6) 「機動戦士ガンダムUC（ユニコーン） (2010-14) / UC 0096-0097 / ラプラスの箱の継承を巡る戦い」, 7) 「機動戦士ガンダムNT（ナラティブ） (2018) / UC 0097 / UCの後継へ」, 8) 「機動戦士ガンダムF91 (1991) / UC 0123 / 新時代の幕開け」, 9) 「機動戦士Vガンダム (1993) / UC 0153 / ザンスカール帝国との戦争」, 10) 「機動戦士ガンダム 閃光のハサウェイ (2021) / UC 0105 / 地球連邦の腐敗と新たな抗争の火種」, 11) 「機動戦士ガンダム ククルス・ドアンの島 (2022) / UC 0083 / 一年戦争中の一編」, 12) 「機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN（左記に記載）」, 13) 「機動戦士ガンダム サンダーボルト (2012-17) / UC 0079-0080 / 一年戦争中の並行世界」, 14) 「機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY (1991-92) / UC 0083 / デラーズ・フリートの襲撃」. Use solid black arrows for chronological flow and dashed arrows for parallel or related works, including arrows connecting THE ORIGIN, the original Gundam, Z, ZZ, Char's Counterattack, Unicorn, Narrative, F91, and V Gundam. Add a small arrow legend below the main panel showing solid arrow 「時系列の流れ」 and dashed arrow 「並行・関連作品」 plus a note that years are approximate.

Middle left section: A bordered panel titled アナザー（AU：Alternate Universe）シリーズ with a note that these are histories/worlds different from UC. Include exactly 6 pastel cards in one row: 1) 「機動戦士ガンダムSEED (2002-03) / C.E.（コズミック・イラ）/ 遺伝子調整者を巡る人類の対立」, 2) 「機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY (2004-05) / C.E.71-73 / SEEDの続編」, 3) 「機動戦士ガンダム00（ダブルオー） (2007-09) / 西暦2307年 / 化石燃料枯渇後の人類の争い」, 4) 「機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ (2015-17) / 西暦（Post Disaster）/ 火星移民後の厳しい社会」, 5) 「機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女 (2022-23) / A.S.（アド・ステラ）122年 / 企業群による支配とモビルスーツ開発競争」, 6) 「新機動戦記ガンダムW (1995-96) / A.C.（アフター・コロニー）/ 宇宙コロニーの独立運動と戦争」. Add a note below that each work has an independent world and era and does not directly connect to UC.

Middle right section: A bordered panel titled 「その他の作品・世界観」 with exactly 2 cards: 1) 「Gのレコンギスタ (2014-15) / R.C.（リギルド・センチュリー）/ 複数の時代が交錯する多層的な世界」, 2) 「∀ガンダム（ターンエー） (1999-2000) / 西暦2345年 / すべてのガンダムの未来の物語」. Add a small note that these are independent from UC.

Bottom area: Include exactly 3 boxes. Left box titled 「まとめ」 with two bullet paragraphs explaining that UC depicts history after humanity expands into space and is the origin world of the series, while AU has different histories/settings and develops independent eras/stories. Center box titled 「凡例」 with exactly 5 color swatches labeled 「一年戦争期」, 「グリプス戦役期」, 「第一次ネオ・ジオン抗争」, 「第二次ネオ・ジオン抗争」, 「ラプラスの箱の時代」. Right box lists abbreviations exactly: 「UC：Universal Century（宇宙世紀）」「C.E.：Cosmic Era（コズミック・イラ）」「A.C.：After Colony（アフター・コロニー）」「A.S.：Ad Stella（アド・ステラ）」「R.C.：Regild Century（リギルド・センチュリー）」 and a small note that names and era notation may differ by work.

Style constraints: Keep all text legible but dense, like a Japanese educational slide; use thin borders, subtle pastel fills, straight connectors, and no character art, no mobile suits, no photos, no watermark.
